newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Pepsi to sign Venezuela deal with Polar - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi to sign Venezuela deal with Polar - paper.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc is to sign a bottling and distribution deal before the end of the month with powerful Venezuelan brewing group Polar, leading daily El Universal reported.

Details are still being worked out, the paper reported company sources as saying, but Pepsi's final stake will be in the order of 30 percent. Neither Pepsi nor Polar spokesmen were immediately available for comment.
Pepsi's Venezuelan operations took a severe blow in August when former Pepsi bottler Grupo Cisneros Embotelladoras de Venezuela defected to arch-rival Coca-Cola Co.
Pepsi, which is currently suing Coca-Cola on monopoly charges, has denied earlier rumors of a possible alliance with Polar.
